models.v1: Frozen Body production proposal + Astra Flow v0 recovery/market/terminal planning
models.v0: Seyamalam-derived production proposal + Astra Flow v0 recovery/market/terminal planning

outputs: gzip JSON full turn log per seed containing all three models

Do not modify Astra Flow v0, Frozen Body, or the pinned opponent.
Treat these three seeds as observation data, not promotion evidence.
